const file=new File(['student,amount,date,source,id\nStudent A,50.00,'+TallyHall.state.day+',Verified bank row 91,qa-import-1\n'],'qa.csv',{type:'text/csv'});const dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(file);document.querySelector('#import-file').files=dt.files;document.querySelector('#import-file').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));

document.querySelector('#import-confirm').checked=true;document.querySelector('#apply-import').click();if(TallyHall.Model.balance(TallyHall.state,TallyHall.state.accounts[0])!==15000)throw Error('CSV import did not update balance'); 'CSV preview and confirmation verified'

TallyHall.accountModal('c');document.querySelector('[data-action=correct-receipt]').click();document.querySelector('#correct-amount').value='400';document.querySelector('#correct-reason').value='Checked original receipt';document.querySelector('#correct-form').requestSubmit();if(TallyHall.Model.balance(TallyHall.state,TallyHall.state.accounts[2])!==10000)throw Error('Correction failed');'Receipt correction reopens collection'

TallyHall.navigate('assistant');TallyHall.assistantAsk('Schedule follow-up for Student A tomorrow');const schedule=document.querySelector('[data-action=schedule]');if(!schedule)throw Error('No schedule preview');schedule.click();if(document.querySelector('#job-due').value!==TallyHall.Model.shift(TallyHall.state.day,1))throw Error('Incorrect proposed date');document.querySelector('#job-reason').value='School agreed next check';document.querySelector('#job-settings-form').requestSubmit();if(TallyHall.Model.jobs(TallyHall.state).find(j=>j.id==='draft:a').due!==TallyHall.Model.shift(TallyHall.state.day,1))throw Error('Date not saved');'Assistant date review updates shared job'
document.querySelector('#confirm-restore').click();if(TallyHall.state.receipts.length!==5)throw Error('Restore did not replace state');'Backup restoration reviewed and verified'
